# Bishnu Bhusal

> Bishnu Bhusal is a computer science researcher working on differential privacy, formal verification, and privacy-preserving machine learning and LLMs. Publications at ACM CCS, AAAI, and OOPSLA.

- Homepage: https://bishnubhusal.com.np/
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Dkp-woMAAAAJ
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7522-5878
- Semantic Scholar: https://www.semanticscholar.org/author/2231871095
- GitHub: https://github.com/bhusalb
